result.fix: Do not edit `/usr/lib/sysctl.d/90-hardening.conf`: an update or a reboot puts it back. Override it. Persist `vm.max_map_count` with `echo 'vm.max_map_count = 262144' | sudo tee -a /etc/sysctl.d/99-rdy.conf`. Then run `sysctl --system` to apply the files. `sysctl -p` does not read `sysctl.d`.
result.message: `vm.max_map_count` is `262144`, as needed, but `/usr/lib/sysctl.d/90-hardening.conf` sets it to `65530` at boot, so a reboot changes it.
notes: Read 2 sysctl configuration file(s), in boot order.
